SELECT 
    rc.loan_id,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM 
    main.risk_classification rc
JOIN 
    main.classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE 
    cg.grade_name_en = 'Substandard'
ORDER BY 
    rc.loan_id ASC;

SELECT payment_id, business_date, amount
FROM payment_event
WHERE payment_type = 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL' AND amount > 5000000
ORDER BY amount DESC;

SELECT p.party_id, pp.annual_income
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON p.party_id = pp.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' AND pp.annual_income > 1000000
ORDER BY pp.annual_income DESC;

SELECT card_id, issued_on, expires_on
FROM payment_card
WHERE card_type = 'CREDIT'
ORDER BY issued_on ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    op.operating_status
FROM 
    main.party p
JOIN 
    main.organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
WHERE 
    op.registered_region = (
        SELECT 
            ou.region_code
        FROM 
            main.organization_unit ou
        WHERE 
            ou.unit_name = '上海分行'
    )
    AND p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
ORDER BY 
    p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM 
    main.organization_unit ou
LEFT JOIN 
    main.account a ON ou.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    account_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.sector_name_zh AS industry_name_zh,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    main.organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    main.industry_sector i ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
GROUP BY 
    i.sector_name_zh
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    SUM(phs.fair_value) AS total_market_value
FROM 
    main.wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    main.product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
GROUP BY 
    wp.product_id, wp.product_name
ORDER BY 
    total_market_value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(pr.relation_id) AS relation_count
FROM 
    main.party_relation pr
JOIN 
    main.party p ON pr.source_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    main.organization_unit ou ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE 
    pr.relation_type IN ('SENIOR_MANAGER', 'AFFILIATE')
GROUP BY 
    ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 
    relation_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    c.net_capital,
    c.risk_weighted_assets
FROM 
    main.capital_snapshot c
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON c.institution_id = i.institution_id
ORDER BY 
    c.net_capital DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(abs.balance) AS total_deposit_balance
FROM 
    main.institution i
JOIN 
    main.account a ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN 
    main.account_balance_snapshot abs ON a.account_id = abs.account_id
WHERE 
    a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
    AND abs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM main.account_balance_snapshot abs2 
        WHERE abs2.account_id = abs.account_id
    )
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_deposit_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    AVG(d.principal_overdue_days) AS avg_overdue_days
FROM 
    main.delinquency_snapshot d
JOIN 
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON d.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    AVG(d.principal_overdue_days) > 90
ORDER BY 
    avg_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT 
    eg.group_type AS exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_exposure,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital AS exposure_ratio
FROM 
    exposure_group eg
JOIN 
    exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN 
    party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    institution inst ON ca.institution_id = inst.institution_id
JOIN 
    capital_snapshot cs ON inst.institution_id = cs.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
ORDER BY 
    exposure_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    COUNT(l.loan_id) AS total_loan_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rc.grade_code IN ('SUBSTANDARD', 'DOUBTFUL', 'LOSS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS npl_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rc.grade_code IN ('SUBSTANDARD', 'DOUBTFUL', 'LOSS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(l.loan_id) AS npl_ratio
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    main.industry_sector i ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
JOIN 
    main.risk_classification rc ON ld.loan_id = rc.loan_id
WHERE 
    rc.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM main.risk_classification WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id)
GROUP BY 
    i.sector_code, i.sector_name_zh
HAVING 
    COUNT(l.loan_id) >= 20
ORDER BY 
    npl_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC
LIMIT !15;

SELECT 
    risk_level,
    COUNT(*) AS product_count,
    AVG(management_fee_rate) AS avg_management_fee_rate
FROM 
    main.wealth_product
GROUP BY 
    risk_level
ORDER BY 
    risk_level ASC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS guarantor_id,
    p.display_name AS guarantor_name,
    SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_balance
FROM 
    main.guarantor_commitment g
JOIN 
    main.party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE 
    g.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY 
    g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    SUM(g.guar!guaranteed_amount) > 500000000.0
ORDER BY 
    total_guaranteed_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN 
    credit_agreement ca ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE 
    pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
GROUP BY 
    p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    SUM(ca.contract_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY 
    total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count,
    SUM(d.observed_value) AS total_observed_value
FROM 
    main.data_security_event_v3 d
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON d.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    d.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    total_observed_value DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_count
FROM 
    main.regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    (r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date)
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY 
    overdue_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    (c.net_capital * 1.0 / c.risk_weighted_assets) AS capital_adequacy_ratio
FROM 
    main.capital_snapshot c
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON c.institution_id = i.institution_id
ORDER BY 
    capital_adequacy_ratio ASC;

SELECT 
    d.loan_id,
    d.principal_overdue_days,
    rc.grade_code,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM 
    main.delinquency_snapshot d
JOIN 
    main.risk_classification rc ON d.loan_id = rc.loan_id
WHERE 
    d.principal_overdue_days > 90
    AND rc.grade_code IN ('NORMAL', 'SPECIAL_MENTION')
ORDER BY 
    d.principal_overdue_days DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS insufficient_provision_loan_balance
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON i.institution_id = (
        SELECT ld.institution_id 
        FROM loan_drawdown ld 
        WHERE ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    )
JOIN 
    provision_snapshot ps ON lbs.loan_id = ps.loan_id AND lbs.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE 
    ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) > 100000000
ORDER BY 
    insufficient_provision_loan_balance DESC;

SELECT 
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    p.display_name AS payee_name,
    i.sector_name_zh AS industry_name_zh,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM 
    main.payment_instruction pi
JOIN 
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    main.organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    main.industry_sector i ON op.industry_code = i.sector_code
WHERE 
    pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
    AND i.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
ORDER BY 
    pi.instruction_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sec.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pe.amount ELSE 0.0 END) AS restricted_outflow_amount,
    SUM(pe.amount) AS total_instruction_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sec.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED',! 'EXIT') THEN pe.amount ELSE 0.0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(pe.amount) AS ratio
FROM 
    main.payment_event pe
JOIN 
    main.account a_to ON pe.to_account_id = a_to.account_id
JOIN 
    main.account_holder ah ON a_to.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN 
    main.party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    main.organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    main.industry_sector sec ON op.industry_code = sec.sector_code
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON a_to.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_id,
    ma.maturity_on AS asset_maturity_date,
    wp.actual_termination_on AS product_termination_date
FROM 
    main.wealth_product wp
JOIN 
    main.product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN 
    main.managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE 
    ma.maturity_on > wp.actual_termination_on
ORDER BY 
    ma.maturity_on DESC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS party_id,
    p.display_name AS party_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT g.commitment_id) AS guarantee_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS loan_agreement_count
FROM 
    main.guarantor_commitment g
JOIN 
    main.party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON g.guarantor_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
GROUP BY 
    g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 
    guarantee_count DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    ptc.name_zh,
    pe.amount,
    ou.unit_name
FROM 
    main.payment_event pe
JOIN 
    main.payment_type_catalog ptc ON pe.payment_type = ptc.payment_type
JOIN 
    main.organization_unit ou ON pe.origin_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE 
    pe.is_cash = 1
    AND pe.amount > 5000000.0
    AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY 
    pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    op.industry_code AS borrower_registered_industry,
    ca.target_industry_code AS agreement_target_industry,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM 
    main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    main.organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
WHERE 
    ca.target_industry_code != op.industry_code
ORDER BY 
    ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    ph_from.party_id AS payer_party_id,
    ph_to.party_id AS payee_party_id
FROM 
    main.payment_event pe
JOIN 
    main.account acc_from ON pe.from_account_id = acc_from.account_id
JOIN 
    main.account acc_to ON pe.to_account_id = acc_to.account_id
JOIN 
    main.account_holder ah_from ON acc_from.account_id = ah_from.account_id AND ah_from.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN 
    main.account_holder ah_to ON acc_to.account_id = ah_to.account_id AND ah_to.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
JOIN 
    main.party ph_from ON ah_from.party_id = ph_from.party_id
JOIN 
    main.party ph_to ON ah_to.party_id = ph_to.party_id
JOIN 
    main.party_relation pr ON (ph_from.party_id = pr.source_party_id AND ph_to.party_id = pr.target_party_id) 
                           OR (ph_from.party_id = pr.target_party_id AND ph_to.party_id = pr.source_party_id)
WHERE 
    pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
ORDER BY 
    pe.amount DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM 
    main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN 
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY 
    ca.agreement_id, p.display_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount
FROM 
    main.payment_event p
JOIN 
    main.service_operator so ON p.operator_id = so.operator_id
JOIN 
    main.organization_unit ou ON so.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON ou.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    p.is_cash = 1
    AND p.amount > 5000000
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY 
    total_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sm.staff_id,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM 
    payment_event pe
JOIN 
    service_operator so ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
JOIN 
    staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN 
    main.account acc_to ON pe.to_account_id = acc_to.account_id
JOIN 
    main.account_holder ah ON acc_to.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN 
    main.party p ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    main.organization_profile op ON p.party_id = op.party_id
JOIN 
    main.industry_sector isec ON op.industry_code = isec.sector_code
WHERE 
    isec.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT')
GROUP BY 
    sm.staff_id
ORDER BY 
    transaction_count DESC
LIMIT !10;

SELECT 
    cdd.record_id,
    i.institution_name,
    cdd.event_date,
    cdd.deadline_date,
    CAST(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(cdd.deadline_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_overdue
FROM 
    main.customer_due_diligence_event_v3 AS cdd
JOIN 
    main.institution AS i ON cdd.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE 
    cdd.completion_date IS NULL
ORDER BY 
    days_overdue DESC
LIMIT !20;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    cl.collateral_id,
    cl.status AS collateral_status,
    sa.status AS security_agreement_status
FROM 
    main.security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    main.collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
WHERE 
    cl.status = 'RELEASED' 
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    sa.security_id ASC;

SELECT 
    ld.loan_id,
    ca.agreement_id,
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown ld
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE 
    ld.status = 'WRITTEN_OFF'
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY 
    sa.secured_amount DESC;

WITH LoanBalances AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_name,
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ld.loan_id ORDER BY lbs.as_of_date DESC) as rn_latest
    FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN main.institution i ON ld.agreement_id IN (
        SELECT agreement_id FROM main.credit_agreement WHERE institution_id = i.institution_id
    )
    JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
),
LatestBalances AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_name,
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance
    FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.in!institution_id
    JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(as_of_date) 
        FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot 
        WHERE loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
),
RankedLoans AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_name,
        loan_id,
        principal_balance,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY institution_name ORDER BY principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC) as balance_rank
    FROM LatestBalances
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    balance_rank
FROM RankedLoans
WHERE balance_rank = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

WITH LoanRanking AS (
    SELECT 
        os.sector_name_zh AS industry_name_zh,
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY os.sector_name_zh ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC) AS rank_in_industry
    FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN main.organization_profile op ON ca.borrower_party_id = op.party_id
    JOIN main.industry_sector os ON op.industry_code =! os.sector_code
    JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot)
)
SELECT 
    industry_name_zh,
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    rank_in_industry
FROM LoanRanking
WHERE rank_in_industry <= 3
ORDER BY industry_name_zh ASC, rank_in_industry ASC;

SELECT 
    business_date,
    txn_count,
    txn_count - LAG(txn_count, 1) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS count_change
FROM (
    SELECT 
        business_date,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_count
    FROM main.payment_event
    GROUP BY business_date
) daily_stats
ORDER BY business_date ASC;

WITH InstAvg AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        AVG(l.principal_balance) AS avg_principal_balance
    FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot l
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON l.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN main.institution i ON ld.agreement_id IN (
        SELECT agreement_id FROM main.credit_agreement WHERE institution_id = i.institution_id
    )
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i![](i.institution_name)
),
LoanDetails AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        l.loan_id,
        l.principal_balance,
        ia.avg_principal_balance,
        (l.principal_balance - ia.avg_principal_balance) AS excess_amount
    FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot l
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON l.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    JOIN InstAvg ia ON i.institution_id = ia.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    avg_principal_balance,
    excess_amount
FROM LoanDetails
WHERE principal_balance > avg_principal_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM 
    main.security_agreement sa
JOIN 
    main.guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
LEFT JOIN 
    main.collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id
WHERE 
    sa.security_type = 'CREDIT'
    AND cl.collateral_link_id IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY 
    sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 1
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN 31
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN 91
        WHEN principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN 181
        ELSE 361
    END AS overdue_interval_start,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM main.delinquency_snapshot
GROUP BY overdue_interval_start
ORDER BY overdue_interval_start ASC;

SELECT 
    collateral_id,
    valued_on,
    COUNT(*) AS duplicate_count
FROM 
    main.collateral_valuation
GROUP BY 
    collateral_id, 
    valued_on
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY 
    collateral_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance,
    AVG(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 AS avg_single_loan_amount
FROM 
    party p
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON p.party_id = (
        SELECT ca.borrower_party_id 
        FROM credit_agreement ca 
        JOIN loan_drawdown ld2 ON ca.agreement_id = ld2.agreement_id 
        WHERE ld2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
JOIN 
    loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE 
    p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY

WITH payment_with_parties AS (
    SELECT 
        p.payment_id,
        p.from_account_id,
        p.to_account_id,
        p.amount,
        p.origin_org_unit_id,
        ah_from.account_id AS from_account_id_check,
        ah_from.party_id AS from_party_id,
        ah_to.account_id AS to_account_id_check,
        ah_to.party_id AS to_party_id,
        COALESCE(acc_from.institution_id, acc_to.institution_id) AS inst_id
    FROM main.payment_event p
    JOIN main.account_holder ah_from ON p.from_account_id = ah_from.account_id AND ah_from.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
    JOIN main.account_holder ah_to ON p.to_account_id = ah_to.account_id AND ah_to.holder_role = 'PRIMARY'
    JOIN main.account acc_from ON p.from_account_id = acc_from.account_id
    JOIN main.account acc_to ON p.to_account_id = acc_to.account_id
),
related_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        pwp.payment_id,
        pwp.amount,
        pwp.inst_id,
        i.institution_name
    FROM payment_with_parties pwp
    JOIN main.party_relation pr 
        ON pwp.from_party_id = pr.source_party_id 
        AND pwp.to_party_id = pr.target_party_id
        AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    JOIN main.institution i ON pwp.inst_id = i.institution_id
),
total_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        inst_id,
        SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM payment_with_parties
    GROUP BY inst_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name AS "机构名称",
    COALESCE(SUM(rp.amount), 0) AS "关联方交易金额",
    tp.total_amount AS "全部交易金额",
    (COALESCE(SUM(rp.amount), 0) * 1.0 / tp.total_amount) AS "占比"
FROM main.institution i
JOIN total_payments tp ON i.institution_id = tp.inst_id
LEFT JOIN related_payments rp ON i.institution_id = rp.inst_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, tp.total_amount
ORDER BY "占比" DESC;

WITH industry_loan_balances AS (

),
industry_with_cumulative AS (

),
industry_cumulative_ratio AS (
    SELECT 
        industry_code,
        total_balance,
        (cumulative_balance * 1.0 / grand_total) AS cumulative_ratio

)
SELECT 
    icr.industry_code AS industry_name,

    icr.cumulative_ratio

SELECT

WHERE 
    ld.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'SETTLED') -- Assuming 'SETTLED' might be considered closed, so we filter for active or similar. Based on schema examples, 'ACTIVE' is the main open status. Let's strictly use 'ACTIVE' and exclude 'WRITTEN_OFF' or 'SETTLED' if they imply closure. The prompt says "unsettled/unpaid". In banking, 'ACTIVE' usually means outstanding.
    -- Re-evaluating based on standard banking: 'ACTIVE' means the loan is currently outstanding. 'SETTLED' and 'WRITTEN_OFF' are closed.

WITH InstAvg AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        AVG(lbs.principal_balance) AS avg_principal_balance
    FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i!instituition_name
)
SELECT 
    ia.institution_name,
    lbs.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    ia.avg_principal_balance,
    (lbs.principal_balance - (ia.avg_principal_balance * 2)) AS excess_difference
FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN InstAvg ia ON ca.institution_id = ia.institution_id
WHERE lbs.principal_balance > (ia.avg_principal_balance * 2)
ORDER BY excess_difference DESC;

WITH all_agreements AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM main.credit_agreement ca
    JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
),
non_related_agreements AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS non_related_amount
    FROM main.credit_agreement ca
    JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    LEFT JOIN main.party_relation pr ON ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id 
        AND pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
    WHERE pr.relation_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
)
SELECT 
    aa.institution_name,
    COALESCE(nra.non_related_amount, 0.0) AS non_related_amount,
    aa.total_amount,
    (COALESCE(nra.non_related_amount, 0.0) * 1.0 / aa.total_amount) AS ratio
FROM all_agreements aa
LEFT JOIN non_related_agreements nra ON aa.institution_id = nra.institution_id
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance,
    c.net_capital,
    (SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / c.net_capital) AS concentration_ratio
FROM 
    main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN 
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN 
    main.capital_snapshot c ON i.institution_id = c.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, p.party_id
HAVING 
    concentration_ratio > 0.10
ORDER BY 
    concentration_ratio DESC
LIMIT 200;

WITH industry_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        target_industry_code,
        AVG(annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM main.credit_agreement
    GROUP BY target_industry_code
)
SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ca.annual_interest_rate AS execution_rate,
    ia.avg_rate AS industry_avg_rate,
    ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - ia.avg_rate) * 100.0 / ia.avg_rate, 2) AS markup_percent
FROM main.credit_agreement ca
JOIN main.party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_avg ia ON ca.target_industry_code = ia.target_industry_code
WHERE (ca.annual_interest_rate - ia.avg_rate) * 100.0 / ia.avg_rate > 10.0
ORDER BY markup_percent DESC, ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.borrower_party_id) AS exceeded_customer_count
FROM 
    main.institution i
JOIN 
    main.capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON i.in!institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN 
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
WHERE 
    cs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM main.capital_snapshot WHERE institution_id = i.institution_id)
    AND lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot WHERE loan_id = lbs.loan_id)
    AND (lbs.principal_balance * 1.0 / cs.net_capital) > 0.10
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 
    exceeded_customer_count DESC;

SELECT

    (SUM(cf.contract_amount) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital) AS concentration_ratio

    main.exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id

GROUP BY

HAVING

ORDER BY

WITH LoanBalances AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_loan_balance
    FROM main.credit_agreement ca
    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.in!institution_name, ca.borrower_party_id
),
Capital AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM main.capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM main.capital_snapshot)
),
Ratios AS (
    SELECT 
        lb.institution_id,
        lb.institution_name,
        p.display_name AS customer_name,
        (lb.total_loan_balance * 1.0 / c.net_capital) AS ratio
    FROM LoanBalances lb
    JOIN Capital c ON lb.institution_id = c.institution_id
    JOIN main.party p ON lb.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
),
Ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_name,
        customer_name,
        ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY institution_id ORDER BY ratio DESC) AS rn
    FROM Ratios
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    customer_name,
    ratio
FROM Ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY institution_id ORDER BY principal_balance DESC) AS quartile
FROM (
    SELECT 
        l.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        i.institution_id
    FROM main.loan_drawdown l
    JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM main.loan_balance_snapshot)
) sub
ORDER BY quartile ASC, principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT 
    l.loan_id,
    i.institution_name,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    ROUND(lbs.principal_balance * 100.0 / inst_total.total_balance, 2) AS ratio_percent
FROM 
    main.loan_drawdown l
JOIN 
    main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON l.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON l.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    (
        SELECT 
            ca2.institution_id,
            SUM(lbs2.principal_balance) AS total_balance
        FROM 
            main.loan_drawdown ld2
        JOIN 
            main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 ON ld2.loan_id = lbs2.loan_id
        JOIN 
            main.credit_agreement ca2 ON ld2.agreement_id = ca2.agreement_id
        GROUP BY 
            ca2.institution_id

ORDER BY 
    i.institution_name ASC,
    ratio_percent DESC,
    l.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

    GROUP BY g.guarantor_party_id

        ld.loan_account_id, -- Placeholder, we need obligor from agreement or facility
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_loan_balance
    FROM main.loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN main.loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id

    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
),
-- Correcting the borrower exposure to group by borrower_party_id from credit_agreement
borrower_exposure_corrected AS (
    SELECT

        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_loan_balance

    JOIN main.loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id

)

SELECT

    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    SUM(dlq.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM

JOIN 
    main.wealth_product wp ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN 
    main.managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN 
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON ma.obligor_party_id = ld.loan_account_id -- Assuming obligor_party_id links to loan via account or directly if schema implies party_id in loan_drawdown needs join via account. Re-evaluating schema: loan_drawdown has loan_account_id (ACC), but delinquency_snapshot links to loan_id. We need to link obligor_party_id to a loan.
    -- Correction: The schema doesn't have a direct party_id in loan_drawdown. 
    -- Let's trace: managed_asset.obligor_party_id -> party. 
    -- How to find loans for a party? 
    -- Table main.account has institution_id, org_unit_id, account_kind, etc. 
    -- Table main.loan_drawdown has loan_account_id (ACC). 
    -- Table main.account has account_id. 
    -- So: managed_asset.obligor_party_id is the borrower. 
    -- We need to find loans where the borrower is this party. 
    -- The schema doesn't explicitly link party_id to loan_id directly in loan_drawdown. 
    -- However, main.account_holder links account_id to party_id. 
    -- And main.loan_drawdown has loan_account_id which should correspond to an account_id in main.account? 
    -- Wait, loan_drawdown.loan_account_id examples are ACC-xxxx. main.account has account_id. 
    -- So: managed_asset.obligor_party_id -> (via account_holder? No, account_holder links account to party). 
    -- Let's assume the obligor_party_id in managed_asset is the party_id of the borrower. 
    -- We need to find loans associated with this party. 
    -- Path: managed_asset.obligor_party_id -> (join account_holder on party_id) -> account_id. 
    -- Then join loan_drawdown on loan_account_id = account_id? 
    -- Then get loan_id from loan_drawdown. 
    -- Then join delinquency_snapshot on loan_id.
    
    -- Let's refine the join path:
    -- 1. phs -> ma (asset_id)
    -- 2. ma.obligor_party_id is the borrower party.
    -- 3. Find accounts owned by this party: main.account_holder (party_id = ma.obligor_party_id) -> account_id.
    -- 4. Find loans linked to these accounts: main.loan_drawdown (loan_account_id = account_holder.account_id).
    -- 5. Get loan_id from loan_drawdown.
    -- 6. Join delinquency_snapshot on loan_id.
    -- 7. Filter delinquency_snapshot to only those where the loan belongs to the current institution (wp.issuer_institution_id). 
    --    Wait, the question says "逾期借据限于该理财产品发行机构本行". 
    --    The loan_drawdown doesn't have institution_id directly, but the account (loan_account_id) has institution_id?

    --    So: loan_drawdown.loan_account_id -> main.account.account_id -> main.account.institution_id.
    --    Check if main.account.institution_id = wp.!
    --    Actually, the loan itself might be identified by loan_id in delinquency_snapshot. 
    --    Does delinquency_snapshot have institution_id? No. 
    --    So we must filter via the account/institution link.

JOIN 
    main.account_holder ah ON ma.obligor_party_id = ah.party_id

    main.account acc ON ah.account_id = acc.account_id

    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        fs.annual_revenue
    FROM main.institution i
    JOIN main.financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
),
total_revenue AS (
    SELECT SUM(annual_revenue) AS sum_revenue FROM institution_revenue
)

    ir.institution_name,
    ir.annual_revenue,
    ROUND(ir.annual_revenue * 1.0 / tr.sum_revenue * 100, 2) AS revenue_ratio

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) AS under_provision_total,
    f.net_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) * 100.0 / f.net_assets, 2) AS under_provision_ratio
FROM 
    main.provision_snapshot p
JOIN 
    main.loan_drawdown ld ON p.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN 
    main.credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN 
    main.institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN 
    main.financial_snapshot f ON f.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE 
    p.recognized_amount < p.required_amount
    AND f.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM main.financial_snapshot WHERE party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id)
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name, f.net_assets
HAVING 
    SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) > 0
ORDER BY 
    under_provision_ratio DESC, i.institution_id ASC;

    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM 
    main.risk_classification rc
JOIN 
    main.classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE 
    rc.classification_basis = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
    AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
GROUP BY

HAVING 
    COUNT(*) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY 
    loan_count DESC,
    risk_classification_name ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS bad_loan_count,
    SUM(ds.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    loan_drawdown ld ON i.institution_id = (SELECT institution_id FROM credit_agreement WHERE agreement_id = ld.agreement_id)
JOIN 
    delinquency_snapshot ds ON ld.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN 
    financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE 
    ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
    AND ds.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM delinquency_snapshot)
    AND fs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM financial_snapshot)
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id
HAVING 
    (SUM(ds.overdue_principal) * 1.0 / fs.annual_revenue) > 0.5
ORDER BY 
    total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT

SELECT

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rse.record_id) AS regulatory_overdue_count,
    AVG(rse.amount_value) AS avg_ledger_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ps.loan_id) AS insufficient_provision_loan_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS provision_gap_amount
FROM 
    institution i
JOIN 
    regulatory_submission_event_v3 rse ON i.institution_id = rse.institution_id
LEFT JOIN 
    provision_snapshot ps ON i.institution_id = (
        SELECT ld.institution_id 
        FROM loan_drawdown ld 
        WHERE ld.loan_id = ps.loan_id 
        LIMIT 1
    ) AND ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
WHERE 
    rse.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
    AND rse.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.in!institution_name
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT rse.record_id) >= 25
ORDER BY 
    provision_gap_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cf.facility_id) AS total_credit_facilities,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN gcr.exception_flag = 1 THEN gcr.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS governance_exception_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(gcr.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_observed_ratio
FROM 
    institution i
LEFT JOIN 
    credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
LEFT JOIN 
    governance_control_record_v3 gcr ON i.in!institution_id = gcr.institution_id
GROUP BY 
    i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN gcr.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
ORDER BY 
    governance_exception_amount DESC, 
    i.institution_name ASC;
